introduction: Read Chapter 25 and its written lab alongside six bounded experiments. Use inline predictions and ordinary Debug at named boundaries. Complete each launched process. The complete MLV1 codec is supplied; only the independent changed-pixel bounds function is unfinished.
conclusion: Explain XOR history, format validation, committed state, record cost, replay and anchored deadlines. Implement minimal exclusive bounds over original native words, then use the final assessment after edits. Optional full-file playback remains in the written lab; the native deadline experiment is an arithmetic model.
